placements.why: The document's content is entirely about calibration — the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work. No existing strata category exists; Calibration is the organizational category this content calls for.
placements.title: Calibration as organizational record
placements.theme: Calibration work and its records are subject to organizational governance, including directed erasure and denial.

placements.title: Calibration knowledge directed to erasure and denial
placements.theme: The organization commands removal of calibration records and retroactively denies the calibration was ever performed.
placements.why: All three segments cohere around a single thematic arc: deliberate erasure of calibration knowledge (src-1, src-2 directives to forget and remove) reinforced by retroactive denial (src-3 assertive that the observatory never calibrated it). This is a directional statement about organizational posture toward calibration records that future envelopes could feed.
